high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter post from the user @forecast... (with a verified blue checkmark), who is identified as Peter Forister. The tweet is about Hurricane Melissa, which was at peak intensity when the satellite image was captured. Tweet Content: The tweet mentions that the Sentinel-2 satellite captured an image of Hurricane Melissa's eye at its peak intensity. It highlights the 10m pixel resolution of the image, noting it as one of the best satellite images ever taken of a hurricane of this intensity. The image was taken at 16z
